# ZOE — account brief

## Who
ZOE runs personalized nutrition programs built on science, with at-home testing and daily guidance in the app ([source](https://joinzoe.com/)). Its GitHub org profile lists the company as ZOE at joinzoe.com ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe)).

## Production Expo signals
- `eas.json` is committed in `joinzoe/zoe-app` ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/blob/main/eas.json)).
- `package.json` in the same repo pins react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/blob/main/package.json)).
- The repo has CI workflows under `.github/workflows` ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- The org has 16 public repos and 88 followers ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe)).
- The org description names a regulated category, health ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe)).
- The App Store listing has 22,000 ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zoe-personalized-nutrition/id1546855982)).
- 8 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zoe-personalized-nutrition/id1546855982)).

## Who to talk to
- Maintainer One (@joinzoe-maintainer-1), top contributor to `joinzoe/zoe-app` with 121 commits; profile lists company ZOE and website https://joinzoe.com ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-1)). No title or location listed.
- Maintainer Two (@joinzoe-maintainer-2), 70 commits to `joinzoe/zoe-app`; profile lists company ZOE and website https://joinzoe.com ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-2)). No title or location listed.
- Maintainer Three (@joinzoe-maintainer-3), 28 commits to `joinzoe/zoe-app`; profile lists company ZOE and website https://joinzoe.com ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-3)). No title or location listed.

## Why now
`joinzoe/zoe-app` was last pushed on 2026-08-17 ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app)), and the store listing shows 8 releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zoe-personalized-nutrition/id1546855982)). The app is on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener
You have 121 commits in `joinzoe/zoe-app`, which builds through EAS on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-1)) ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/blob/main/package.json)). The repo also runs its own GitHub Actions workflows ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)), and the store listing shows 8 releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zoe-personalized-nutrition/id1546855982)). With that cadence, does a JS-only fix go out over the air on a channel, or does it wait for the next build in those workflows?
